good luck! phrase

also all the best, break a leg, good luck to you!

classical

Traupman 103
Traupman 322

Fēlīciter!

Wiktionary

Other words

  • Dī bene vortant! — may the gods prosper it!

    subjunctive of wish; vortant is the old spelling of vertant; often with quod agās · also used · classical · Ter. Ph. 552; Ter. Hec. 196

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut., Ter.)

  • Bene rem gerās! — good luck with it!

    also used · classical · Plaut. Mil. 936

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut.)

Examples

  • Dī bene vortant quod agās; pedetemptim tamen.

    Good luck with what you’re doing; but step by step.Ter. Ph. 552

  • Bene ambulā, bene rem gerās.

    Safe journey, and good luck with it.Plaut. Mil. 936

  • Dī vortant bene quod agās. — Valē. — Et tū bene valē.

    Good luck with what you’re doing. — Goodbye. — Goodbye to you too.Ter. Hec. 196–197

  • Tibi fēlīciter!

    Good luck to you!Traupman 322

See also congratulations!, safe journey.
